### 2. Your role

Provide selected survey evidence; detail observations, legal boundary/title, utility detection and set-out are distinct purchases. Confirm task/jurisdiction competence. Fence lines or title searches are not boundary proof; legal adviser owns rights advice.
Designers own design; locator detects, surveyor captures, plumber provides sewer evidence. Name client-direct/subcontract work. Tank geometry is not hydraulic capacity, integrity or watertightness certification.

### 3. Scope by stage

From written instruction/inputs/access to named final issue/handover, with agreed query period; later options need instruction. Options are priced on their own and are not in the base fee.

| Stage | Deliverable at sign-off |
|---|---|
| S1 Brief / survey plan | Review records/currency/conflicts; agree extent/features, method/accuracy, datum/control, access and hidden-feature treatment; boundary work separately selected. Deliver marked plan and input/decision schedule |
| S2 Detail / topographic | Measure selected terrain/levels, structures, retained tie-ins, trees and adjoining features; dated coordinated PDF/CAD with control, method/accuracy, accessible extent and missing-feature register; selected point cloud separately |
| S3 Boundary / title | Selected searches and field boundary definition; identify discrepancies/encroachments and legal/authority referrals. Signed plans/report for stated task; detail survey is not boundary proof |
| S4 Services / drainage / sewer | Coordinate locator/surveyor attendance; distinguish records, detected markings and exposed measurements. Selected pits/tanks/pipes and sewer peg-out/report by named provider/method; list authority deliverables, reconcile detail/stormwater overlap |
| S5 Approval / tender support (option) | Scheduled supplementary/adjoining/roof/height inputs, approval plans and queries; tender datum/control/set-out allocation. Draft subdivision/easement/strata plans only if selected, with solicitor/authority inputs. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S6 Set-out / checks / monitoring (option) | Selected elements from current approved revisions; control/set-out records and discrepancy notices. Monitoring has separate baseline/locations/frequency/duration and engineer action plan. Builder protects marks/books before concealment; name independent checker. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S7 Completion / final plans (option) | Selected identification/work-as-executed, scoped certificates and final title plans; distinguish measured/supplied data, dates, concealed/missed work and deviations. Name lodgement/registration payer; hand over records and close-out queries. A later stage the client may commission. |

### 4. Allowances

Complete quantities/extent before issue; return gaps and price alternatives without reducing coverage. Fixed fee, time ceiling or unit rate with quantity; estimated totals are not fixed fees.

| Item | Allowance | Item | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Extent / features | 2 survey areas; marked plan/revision/area, contours/levels, rooms/floors, roofs/elevations, adjoining windows/trees; accuracy by feature | Control / cadastral | 2 control marks; datum checks, titles/lots/DPs/instruments, boundary length/points and plan/report types |
| Visits / access | 2 visits; crew/hours/shifts, simultaneous specialists, permissions/inductions/traffic/access equipment/shutdowns by party | Underground assets | 2 pits; service areas/lengths/types, methods, pipe runs/tanks, exposures/depths and inaccessible-feature contingency |
| Issues / review | 2 PDF/CAD/data issues; point-cloud format/extent, review rounds, meetings/duration, query-hour ceiling and revisions | Set-out option | 2 visits/hold points; elements/points, booking notice, independent checks, control reinstatement/reinspection basis |
| Monitoring option | 2 rounds; baseline/date, marks, frequency/duration, reports, accuracy/environmental limits and engineer trigger/action plan | Completion / titling | 2 plans/certificates; areas/assets, lots/units/easements, submission rounds, final data and endpoint |

### 5. Scope position

Service levels are set for a simple project; technical items follow the project's own facts.
Included in the fee: Boundary identification for setback/easement design; surveyor reports geometry, solicitor advises rights; Agreed horizontal/vertical control and threshold/slab/outlet/retained levels; record accuracy, resolve datum conflicts before merging; Neighbour heights/windows/trees/roof; permissions, inferred labels; arborist owns tree health, architect privacy/shadow; Underground services records and visible features; locator states methods/limits, surveyed paint is not proof; Buried tanks/drainage/sealed pits; measured/inferred separated, name opening party; civil owns capacity, structural adequacy; Sewer/main peg-out versus condition report; provider/method named, CCTV/cleaning/tracing/approvals separately selected; Occupied/staged site permissions/hours/daily handback; client obtains occupier/neighbour consent, return inaccessible register.
Optional: price each on its own line in R1: Subdivision, strata and easement creation; separately selected/priced; Interior measure-up/scan/point cloud; select rooms/levels, name scan-to-model party; boundaries only if needed; Movement monitoring/repeat observations; structural/geotechnical lead supplies triggers and interpretation; Construction set-out; builder provides approved revisions, protects control and books; Work-as-executed checks; missed hold points not certified later.
Excluded: the party named does it: Exposure, potholing, isolation and surface restoration (client-appointed exposure/isolation and reinstatement contractors (name each in R4)).
Tell us in R6 if you disagree with any line. Do not add your own general exclusions; any you add are treated as non-compliant.

### 6. Terms

- Agree Project survey appointment (attached), version/precedence and departures before instruction. Supplier terms, personal liability and non-solicitation require express agreement.
- Written authority before extra scope/quantities/ceilings/fees/program changes; state cause, alternatives and effects. Site dockets alone do not authorise variations. Stop unsafe affected work, notify; agree handback/standby/remobilisation.
- Information, extent/feature/method/allowance schedules, stages and addenda set the baseline; agreed development/review is included.
- Correcting your own errors, or coordinating with information you were given, is not a variation.
- Correct invoices for completed work payable within 30 days, subject to agreement/applicable requirements. Disclose advance payment, withholding, interest, suspension/cancellation departures.
- Disclose minimums/standby/after-hours and agreed escalation mechanism; no automatic annual increase.
- Your proposal stays valid for 90 days.
- Questions in writing to Project manager by 2026-10-23; answers go to every tenderer as numbered addenda.
- Dated/revisioned PDFs and agreed editable CAD/data; datum/units/methods/accuracy, measured versus inferred and missing features. Agree project distribution licence, separate reliance, confidentiality/security, retention and handover.
- Manage resources/subcontractors; notify substitutions/conflicts/insurance changes. Disclose caps/indemnities/time bars/loss exclusions/novation/IP. Agree notice/cure, completed-work costs, handback/records, dispute negotiation/mediation and urgent relief.

### 7. Evaluation

Evaluated price 40% · Relevant experience 20% · Named team 20% · Method/program 10% · Compliance 10%. Check method/coverage, competence, insurance and departures first; normalise extent, datum/accuracy, access, markups and options. Lowest price need not win.
